description: Estimate the USD total for a provider and model using measured token counts. Pass usage as reported by the provider, including cache, reasoning, and search counts when available. An unavailable rate returns an error. Use get_prices to inspect rates when usage is unknown.

cache_read_tokens.description: Number of cached input tokens read; omitted values are sent as zero.

cache_write_tokens.description: Number of input tokens written to cache; omitted values are sent as zero.

completion_tokens.description: Number of output tokens reported for the request.

prompt_tokens.description: Number of input tokens reported for the request.

reasoning_tokens.description: Number of reasoning tokens reported; omitted values are sent as zero.

web_search_count.description: Number of web searches performed; omit when unavailable.

name: calculate_cost
title: Estimate inference cost
